unsourced_earth_constants.name: xmind
unsourced_earth_constants.bites: the thinnest ice the model carries, and through zrcpl = xmind*CRHOI*CPI the heat capacity of the skin-temperature layer.

unsourced_earth_constants.name: thicec
unsourced_earth_constants.bites: whether a cell is MASKED as iced, at icestep and mkicec.

unsourced_earth_constants.name: cicemin
unsourced_earth_constants.bites: whether falling snow lands on the modelled ice or melts into the water, at subsnow's two sites. A SECOND threshold on the same field as thicec and not a restatement of it; it was unreachable until world-xdmj, so a bracket that moved thicec left this one at its compiled value.

unsourced_earth_constants.name: albice
unsourced_earth_constants.bites: the cold end of the broadband sea-ice albedo ramp.

unsourced_earth_constants.name: albicemn
unsourced_earth_constants.bites: the warm end of the broadband sea-ice albedo ramp, at the melting point.

unsourced_earth_constants.name: charnock
unsourced_earth_constants.bites: the roughness length over open water, through charnock*|tau|*gascon*T/(ga*p). Upstream's trailing comment called it an albedo, copied from the line above it; it is not one.

unsourced_earth_constants.name: dz0sea
unsourced_earth_constants.bites: the floor under the Charnock roughness, and the cold-start value.

unsourced_earth_constants.name: dz0ice
unsourced_earth_constants.bites: the roughness length of the modelled sea ice.
